verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents running shell commands in sandboxes through its SDK, with process management and real-time log streaming (docs-17, docs-20). It also supports scheduled commands (docs-26) and Dockerfile-based sandbox images with pre-installed tools and languages (docs-32), which covers installing packages at build time. missing for 10: explicit documentation of installing packages at runtime (e.g. apt/pip inside a running sandbox, root/sudo access given the non-root option), independent or hands-on corroboration.
